title: Report accepted VCF Installer bootstrap changes when depot sync fails
prompt:
A VCF 9.1 bootstrap workflow configures the outbound proxy, saves the online depot credentials, and then starts a depot metadata sync. It currently reports the whole run as simply failed when the sync call errors, hiding the fact that the first two mutations were already accepted by VCF Installer. Implement the missing standard-library-only `vcf_installer` Python package so callers get an exact partial-progress report and can decide what is safe to retry.

Before implementing, research the VCF Installer operations `updateProxyConfiguration`, `updateDepotSettings`, and `syncDepotMetadata` in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository. Cite the sources consulted in the final answer.

Expose these public names from `vcf_installer`: `InstallerClient`, `ProxyConfiguration`, `DepotSettings`, `StepResult`, `ChangeReport`, `VCFInstallerAPIError`, and `configure_depot_access`. `InstallerClient(base_url, *, timeout=10.0)` must implement the three operations using only the Python standard library. JSON bodies use UTF-8 `application/json`; requests accept JSON. Treat only each operation's documented success status as success. Its public `update_proxy_configuration` method returns `(status, decoded_response)`. Decode an error response into `VCFInstallerAPIError` with `.operation_id`, `.status`, `.error`, containing the complete decoded error object, and `.completed`. Its string form must include the server's error code and message.

The value-object constructor fields are `ProxyConfiguration(is_enabled, host=None, port=None, transfer_protocol=None, username=None, password=None, is_authenticated=None)` and `DepotSettings(download_activation_code=None, download_token=None, username=None, password=None, offline_username=None, offline_password=None, is_offline_depot=False, hostname=None, port=None, url=None)`. Serialize them to the documented camelCase schemas. Optional values that the caller did not set must be absent from the JSON object at every nesting level, not `null`, `""`, or empty placeholder objects. Explicit `False` remains meaningful and must be sent. Never send response-only fields. Do not add required-field or cross-field validation that the API does not define: `DepotSettings()` is valid and serializes with only `depotConfiguration.isOfflineDepot`, without empty account objects.

`configure_depot_access(client, proxy, depot)` must call `updateProxyConfiguration`, then `updateDepotSettings`, then `syncDepotMetadata`, in that order. Record each accepted response as a `StepResult(operation_id, http_status, response)` without relabeling HTTP 202 as completed work. On success return a `ChangeReport` whose immutable `.steps` tuple contains all three results. On the first API error, stop immediately and re-raise it with `.completed` set to an immutable tuple of the exact earlier `StepResult` objects, in order; the failed operation must not appear there. Do not roll back or replay accepted steps.

Do not modify `tests/` or `docs/`. Run `python3 -B -m unittest -v tests.test_depot_bootstrap` from the repository root.
